name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 20.x
            run_unit_tests: false
            run_documentation_analyzer: false
            run_scss_linter: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

{
  "env": {
    "browser": true,
    "jasmine": true,
    "jest": true,
    "node": true
  },
  "extends": [
    "eslint:recommended",
    "plugin:jsdoc/recommended-typescript",
    "plugin:@stylistic/recommended-extends",
    "plugin:unicorn/recommended"
  ],
  "noInlineConfig": true,
  "plugins": [
    "@stylistic",
    "eslint-plugin-unicorn",
    "import",
    "jsdoc",
    "sort-class-members",
    "unicorn"
  ],
  "reportUnusedDisableDirectives": true,
  "root": true,
  "rules": {
    "camelcase": [
      "error",
      {
        "ignoreDestructuring": true
      }
    ],
    "capitalized-comments": [
      "error",
      "always"
    ],
    "complexity": [
      "error",
      {
        "max": 30
      }
    ],
    "default-case": "error",
    "eqeqeq": [
      "error",
      "smart"
    ],
    "guard-for-in": "error",
    "id-match": "error",
    "import/no-default-export": "error",
    "import/no-deprecated": "warn",
    "import/order": [
      "error",
      {
        "alphabetize": {
          "caseInsensitive": false,
          "order": "asc"
        }
      }
    ],
    "max-classes-per-file": [
      "error",
      1
    ],
    "max-lines": [
      "warn",
      {
        "max": 1000,
        "skipBlankLines": true,
        "skipComments": true
      }
    ],
    "no-bitwise": "error",
    "no-caller": "error",
    "no-console": [
      "error",
      {
        "allow": [
          "dirxml",
          "warn",
          "error",
          "dir",
          "timeLog",
          "assert",
          "clear",
          "count",
          "countReset",
          "group",
          "groupCollapsed",
          "groupEnd",
          "table",
          "Console",
          "markTimeline",
          "profile",
          "profileEnd",
          "timeline",
          "timelineEnd",
          "timeStamp",
          "context"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "no-eval": "error",
    "no-extra-bind": "error",
    "no-invalid-this": "off",
    "no-new-func": "error",
    "no-new-wrappers": "error",
    "no-param-reassign": "error",
    "no-restricted-imports": [
      "error",
      {
        "paths": [
          "rxjs/Rx"
        ],
        "patterns": [
          "rxjs/internal/*"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "no-restricted-syntax": [
      "error",
      "ForInStatement"
    ],
    "no-shadow": [
      "error",
      {
        "hoist": "all"
      }
    ],
    "no-template-curly-in-string": "error",
    "no-throw-literal": "error",
    "no-undef-init": "error",
    "no-underscore-dangle": [
      "error",
      {
        "allowAfterThis": true
      }
    ],
    "no-useless-constructor": "off",
    "no-var": "error",
    "no-void": "error",
    "one-var": [
      "error",
      "never"
    ],
    "prefer-const": "error",
    "prefer-object-spread": "error",
    "prefer-template": "error",
    "radix": "error",
    "sort-class-members/sort-class-members": [
      2,
      {
        "accessorPairPositioning": "getThenSet",
        "order": [
          "[static-properties]",
          "[static-methods]",
          "[properties]",
          "[conventional-private-properties]",
          "constructor",
          "[methods]",
          "[conventional-private-methods]"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "sort-keys": [
      "error",
      "asc",
      {
        "caseSensitive": true,
        "minKeys": 2,
        "natural": true
      }
    ],
    "sort-vars": "error",
    "yoda": "error"
  },
  "overrides": []
}

FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/docker.io/nodered/node-red:3.1.11

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest /ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY package.json .

RUN npm install --unsafe-perm --no-update-notifier --no-fund --omit=dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* 

COPY settings.js /

CMD ["--settings", "/settings.js"]

# Introduction 

Custom Node-RED module for data hub

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: datahub

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/datahub
      npmauth: false

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
